results.text: Comparison of the effectiveness of aliskiren and ramipril for the management of hypertension: A systematic review and meta-analysis. Ramipril is an important option in the management of hypertension, while the role of aliskiren is still up for debate. We aim to meta-analyse and compare the effect of aliskiren with ramipril by measuring mean difference in systolic blood pressure (mdSBP) and mean difference in diastolic blood pressure (mdDBP).
